The workbook generation failed because expected data cells in the 'Task' sheet were empty (None), causing multiple assertion failures.
The test_lookup_blocks and test_derived_values_and_stats failed with AssertionError because cells in ranges H12:L17 and H35:L40 returned None instead of the expected numeric values. Specifically, 'top block' and 'net metric' matrices were missing data. Ensure the logic populates the 'Task' worksheet at the exact coordinates (e.g., H12, I35) defined in the verifier's EXPECTED_TOP and EXPECTED_NET maps.
